case.name: latest-qwen35-2b-text-bf16-cpu-tp2-b4-ctx4096-split-v4
case.note: Fresh experimental Qwen3.5 text baseline: only the last-axis Q/K/V split changes to tensor_split. Original BF16 weights, FP32 recurrent state, TP2/B4/context4096, standard CPU sampler, six context and six decode buckets. Explicit context buckets equal the original SDK defaults. Compilation and all correctness/serving gates pending. Vision and MTP excluded; no speedup claimed against the failed old baseline.

scope: Previously compiled v4 tensor_split graphs, original weights and sequence protocol; seven in-place-cleared device-state experiments, two native-HF causal streams repeated in slots0/2 and1/3. Prefill and two teacher-forced B4 decode steps, 84 full-vocabulary frames. Covers all six context and six decode bucket routes, with all96 state tensors raw-zero before each prefix. Native-HF full-causal oracle with its existing short incremental crosscheck. Not an accuracy certification beyond these frames or a throughput test.
